hypothesis: A base oil whose identity, lot, chemistry family, and solvency-relevant properties are recorded can enter the design space without any property being invented.
uncertainty: Synthetic test fixture / NOT_FOR_PHYSICAL_EXECUTION: supplier values are supplied, not independently verified, and the aniline point has not been measured yet.

evidence.statement: Synthetic test fixture / NOT_FOR_PHYSICAL_EXECUTION: supplier datasheet records the trade name, lot, and KV100 of the base oil.

decision_rule: Register a material only with identity (supplier / trade name / lot), a chemistry family, at least one recorded property, and a dated price; a property without a supplier value is recorded with status GAP.
result: The base oil candidate is recorded as a design-space material; the solvency-relevant aniline point remains an open GAP.
